prospective_contrast: At fixed u and h, compare histories with the same mean but different order, such as [1,0,0,0] versus [0,0,0,1]. The representation predicts a response difference through history_trend; indistinguishable responses within the calibrated 0.015-unit readout bound would refute retaining this order-sensitive summary.

quantities.interpretation: Average of the four prior drives, preserving their overall level.
quantities.name: history_mean

quantities.interpretation: Difference between newest and oldest prior drive, measuring a linear recency trend.
quantities.name: history_trend

refutation_condition: Reject this model if its fit-only parameter estimation and dev-selected sparse polynomial cannot achieve raw-response RMSE <= 0.06 on the supplied dev rows, or if later independent matched-condition predictions exceed that criterion.
scientific_change: Revise the instantaneous-input assumption to let response depend on both the average prior drive and its temporal direction. The distinct responses for equal-mean reordered histories reject a mean-only summary; intermediate entries and nonlinear time kernels remain unresolved.
